source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.7, printed pages 85-86.

blocks.text: Bohat se kimiyai amal mein reactants balanced muadle ke tanasub mein maujood nahi hote. Aksar kisi saste reactant ki bari miqdar di jati hai, taake mehnge reactant ka poora mass matloob product mein badal jaye, zyada se zyada product bane, aur reaction ki raftar barhe. Oxygen ki bari miqdar cheezon ko tezi se jalati hai: aakhir mein zaid oxygen bach jati hai aur doosra reactant, yani fuel, pehle kharch ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Limiting reactant
blocks.text: Woh reactant jo pehle kharch ho jaye, aur yun kimiyai reaction mein banne wale product ki miqdar par qaboo rakhe, limiting reactant ya reagent hai. Us ke kharch hote hi reaction ruk jati hai aur mazeed product nahi banta.
Banne wale product ki miqdar us reactant se mehdood hai jo poora istemal hota hai, aur product ki zyada se zyada miqdar mixture mein limiting reactant ki miqdar par munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt: Aag ko kambal se dhanp kar bujhaya jata hai. Limiting aur excess reactants ke lihaz se wazahat karein ke aag kyun bujh jati hai.
blocks.explanation: Aag fuel ka oxygen ke saath jalna hai. Aam taur par oxygen zaid hoti hai aur fuel reaction ko mehdood karta hai. Dhanpne se oxygen ki rasad combustion ki zaroorat se neeche gir jati hai, to oxygen limiting reactant ban jati hai; maujood oxygen kharch hote hi reaction ruk jati hai halanke fuel baqi hai.

items: Saste reactant ki zaid miqdar mehnge ko poora badalne, product barhane aur reaction tez karne ke liye di jati hai; pehle kharch hone wala reactant limiting reactant hai, jo zyada se zyada product tai karta hai.
